items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
items.description: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant admin consent needed to use CRM notes. Only notes added by users with a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license are used, and Dataverse search is needed only for emails and Teams meetings, since notes are already linked to their records. These control toggles are available automatically. Admins can turn each source on or off in the Agent behavior section of the Data Enrichment settings. Outlook emails and Teams meetings stay off until their permissions are connected, and connecting a permission never turns a source on by itself. For organizations already using the agent, CRM notes is off by default and a banner lets admins know it's available. For new organizations, CRM notes is on by default.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Customize the Procurement Agent supplier follow-up criteria
items.description: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
items.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
items.description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
items.description: When users insert content in a prompt using 'Add Work Content' under the Plus menu, the content will only appear as a pill in the Input Box UI and will not be repeated as part of the user's prompt. This helps to simplify the Input Box and reserve it for prompt creation. Updated April 22, 2026: We are moving this item back to In Development and will be relaunching after further updates. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
items.description: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat. Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
items.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Outlook: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
items.description: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value. This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
items.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

items.title: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
items.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every change.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
items.description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s)
items.description: Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s).

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Overview of recent comments and changes in Word
items.description: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

items.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
items.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
items.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
items.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule. New capabilities include: Configure optimization plans to run on a recurrence schedule. Add and weight additional objectives to optimization goals. These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and are automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent overview .

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
items.description: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance. Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations. Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
items.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find. This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
items.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent
items.description: This feature improves PO matching quality in Payables Agent and aligns draft finalization behavior with existing posting controls. The agent uses an enriched PO Lines list page during matching that includes these fields: Line Amount — enables matching on value, not just description and quantity. This field is especially valuable for service lines where quantity (often just 1) isn't a meaningful discriminator. Expected Receipt Date — helps the agent factor in timing when multiple PO lines could match. By using these fields, the agent can more reliably distinguish between similar-looking PO lines, which improves accuracy in first-pass matches. The agent now respects the app's Never block draft finalization setting in the Receipt on Invoice field on purchase orders. This change means the agent doesn't block draft finalization because a matched PO line isn't yet marked as received. Whether goods are received is a posting time control, not a draft time control. The "Receipt on Invoice" setting on the order governs this behavior at posting. The "Receipt on Invoice" field is already available on purchase orders. With this release, we're expanding this setting to more entities: A new vendor-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting is introduced and automatically applied to new purchase orders created for a vendor. A new PO-line-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting allows per-line override. The inheritance chain for the setting is vendor, then purchase order, and then purchase order line, but each level can override the parent. We've also improved draft warnings. When the agent creates a purchase invoice draft matched to a PO, the draft surfaces warnings based not just on quantity, but also on amount. The draft warnings are for information only and don't block finalization. For example, they warn about the discrepancies in the draft and you can decide how to proceed.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
items.description: The updated Sales plugin brings expanded Dynamics 365 Sales context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork, building on the native Sales skills already available in Cowork. Sellers can work with sales data and take supported actions directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Sales. The native Sales skills invoke tools published through the Dynamics 365 MCP server to retrieve sales context and perform supported actions in Dynamics 365 Sales. These native Sales skills are included in the Sales plugin, which will be delivered through the updated MOS package for the Sales app, providing administrators with a governed way to deploy and manage the capabilities.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Updates to Agent UI experience
items.description: Manage agents more easily by grouping avatars and using a dedicated action to start new tasks.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage agent permissions easier
items.description: Assign additional permissions to agents when they request them.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: User experiences - Agent actions review notifications on lists
items.description: Show and manage documents where agents require human interaction by using a new review bar on documents and lists.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: User experience - Preview images directly in web client
items.description: You can open image attachments in the Business Central web client without downloading the images first. Files display in preview mode with an easy to use viewer experience that's similar to the print preview or PDF preview features. If you want to save a copy, you can download the image file from the viewer. This feature works across all areas of Business Central, including agents, email, and code from extensions. However, extension developers must add support for this feature using File.ViewFromStream for Business Central online, or File.View for Business Central on-premises. These methods follow the pattern of the File.Download method. Preview images directly supports the following types of image files: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, SVG, WEBP, ICO, plus GIF and AVIF (both include animated versions). On the Safari browser, this feature also supports TIFF and TIF. The following are a couple of additional benefits: There is suport for GIF files as FactBox thumbnails, including animation for GIFs up to 48 frames. Thumbnail previews are clickable for images and the first page of PDFs, which open the previewer window.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Review content generated by agents directly on pages
items.description: This improvement introduces the ability for Business Central users to review and approve content generated by agents directly on the pages where they work. You no longer need to navigate to separate task pane to understand that a given document was created by an agent. Instead, agent-generated suggestions—such as descriptions, text proposals, or field-specific updates—appear inline where they can be evaluated and modified before being applied. By keeping the review process within the page context, users maintain flow, reduce clicks, and ensure content quality with minimal disruption. The feature builds on existing Business Central autofill user interface patterns ensuring admins and users can adopt it as part of existing agent-powered daily workflows. Business Value: The ability to review agent-generated content directly on pages helps organizations streamline their daily work while maintaining accuracy and control. You can evaluate suggestions in the context of the task you are performing, reducing interruptions and improving the quality of the final output.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in list
items.description: This feature introduces visual avatars in Business Central list pages to indicate which user or agent created or last modified a record. The capability enhances traceability and supports collaborative work by making identity information immediately visible without opening the record. The avatars reflect either a named Business Central user, a system user or an AI agent, following the existing identity model. Users can hover over the avatar to see a tooltip with the full display name and record update timestamp (if available). This improvement benefits roles that frequently work with shared data—including accountants, order processors, warehouse staff, service teams, and administrators—by reducing time spent verifying ownership or responsibility for items, documents, or configuration entries. It also helps organizations adopting AI-generated records understand when an automated agent has contributed. The feature surfaces existing Created By and Modified By fields more intuitively while respecting Business Central’s data privacy and permissions model. Business Value: Supporting avatars for the users or agents who created and last modified entries makes record ownership clearer and easier to understand across Business Central. By surfacing identity information directly in list pages, you can quickly determine responsibility, follow up with the right person, and work with shared data more confidently.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
items.description: This feature introduces a dedicated task pane in Business Central that displays all tasks generated by the agents. The task pane appears as an additional panel in the user interface and can be opened from anywhere in Business Central. Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow-ups access to draft documents, and other agent-initiated actions. Users can review task details, navigate directly to the affected record, complete tasks, or dismiss them. This improvement primarily benefits roles that rely heavily on AI-driven workflows—such as accountants, sales people, and managers—who often engage with multiple agents throughout the day. The task pane reduces friction by collecting all insights in a single location, minimizing missed tasks and improving throughput. Business Value: The Show all agent tasks on a separate task pane feature help organizations get more value from Microsoft Copilot in Business Central by giving users a single, structured place to review and act on AI-generated tasks. Instead of relying on notifications scattered across different pages, users gain a clear, consolidated overview of all tasks created by agents working in finance, purchasing, sales, and operations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Enable Microsoft Copilot chat experience
items.description: The updated Microsoft Copilot chat experience introduces a modern, consistent, and intuitive interface that aligns Business Central with the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem. The enhancement modernizes the chat panel, streamlines navigation, and improves user workflows by adopting familiar interaction patterns from Microsoft Copilot. This update benefits users who regularly interact with Copilot to accelerate daily tasks - especially operations managers, accountants, sales representatives, and administrators who rely on conversational assistance to navigate and analyse data. It also provides a more predictable experience across Microsoft 365 applications, reducing onboarding time and helping organizations adopt AI capabilities more systematically. Business Value: The updated Copilot chat experience provides a familiar and consistent AI experience across Business Central and Microsoft applications. You get started faster, switch more easily between applications, and interact with AI more confidently, helping improve productivity and accelerate adoption.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Debug recorded Business Central failures with an AI agent
items.description: "Describe a failing scenario to an AI agent, record the next matching Business Central session or a known session, and collect its snapshot for offline AL debugging. Business value: Developers can investigate intermittent or production-only AL failures by describing the problem to an AI agent and reproducing the scenario, without manually configuring and operating the snapshot debugger. The agent arms the recording, monitors its status, and collects the completed snapshot for offline debugging. This guided workflow makes snapshot debugging more accessible and helps support teams capture the execution that caused an error even when the affected session doesn't yet exist."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging
items.description: "Write AL MCP server diagnostics to a configurable file, select the appropriate detail level for troubleshooting, or turn file logging off when it isn't required. Business value: Developers and administrators can retain AL MCP server diagnostics for troubleshooting intermittent failures and reviewing agent activity. Configurable verbosity helps capture detailed information during investigation without permanently producing excessive logs."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Configure AL MCP workspaces dynamically
items.description: "Start the AL MCP server without a predefined project, add AL projects at runtime, and use configured connection details in headless scenarios without authentication prompts. Business value: AI-agent hosts can start a reusable AL MCP server before the target project is known, then load projects as work begins. This supports flexible agent sessions, shared tooling configurations, and headless automation without requiring a separate server process for every preconfigured workspace."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Let agents allocate free AL object IDs
items.description: "Let coding agents find available IDs for AL objects and extension objects within project ranges, reducing manual range checks and collisions with existing project objects. Note that only IDs in connected environment are considered. Business value: Coding agents can scaffold AL objects without manually reading ID ranges or risking collisions with objects already declared in the project. This makes generated code more reliable and reduces the corrections needed before it compiles."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Discover objects in connected Business Central environments
items.description: "Search objects installed in a connected Business Central environment, including owning-app metadata needed to add dependencies and download the correct symbols. Business value: Developers and coding agents can discover AL objects that are installed in the target Business Central environment even when the corresponding symbols haven't yet been downloaded into the workspace. This reduces failed searches and helps agents add the correct app dependency before generating code that uses an object."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Use AL language intelligence from AI agents and other editors
items.description: "Run the standalone AL language server to provide completion, navigation, references, rename, formatting, and other project-aware LSP features outside Visual Studio Code. Business value: Teams can use full AL language intelligence in AI coding agents and development environments that support the Language Server Protocol (LSP), without requiring Visual Studio Code as the client. This opens AL development to additional editors and agentic workflows while retaining accurate project-aware navigation and refactoring."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Get clearer guidance for AL object structure
items.description: "Use compiler diagnostic AL0926 to identify AL object sections declared in the wrong order instead of interpreting multiple secondary and less specific parser errors. Business value: Developers and coding agents receive a direct explanation when sections of an AL object are declared in the wrong order. The clearer diagnostic reduces time spent interpreting secondary parser errors and makes automated code generation easier to correct."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Development - Profile slow Business Central sessions with AI agents
items.description: "Let an AI agent schedule profiling for a Business Central session, collect CPU and memory data, identify costly AL paths, and summarize SQL and HTTP activity. Business value: Developers and administrators can investigate slow Business Central sessions with help from an AI agent instead of manually collecting and interpreting performance profiles. The agent can capture the affected session, identify expensive AL call paths, and summarize whether CPU or managed-memory usage contributes to the problem. This guided workflow shortens the time from a reported performance problem to actionable code-level findings, even when the user isn't already debugging the session."

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run data queries with MCP Server
items.description: Use new MCP tools to define, validate, and run custom data queries. Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Calculate withholding tax automatically in expense reports
items.description: Organizations can automatically calculate employee withholding taxes (WHT) as part of the expense report process. When employees submit expenses that are subject to withholding tax requirements, the system applies the appropriate tax calculations directly within the expense report workflow. Key capabilities include: Automatic withholding tax calculation for employee expense transactions that require tax deductions. Calculate single or multiple withholding taxes for each category, based on you setup. Calculations can also be simple or compound. Calculate thresholds based on different periods for records, documents, categories (period accumulation), and total (period accumulation). Base calculations on gross or net amounts.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Calculate and report VAT based on expense reports
items.description: Expense Agent supports automated VAT handling for expense reports, which can help simplify tax management and improve reporting accuracy. Key capabilities include: Automatic VAT Calculation : Expense Agent identifies VAT-relevant expense transactions and calculates applicable VAT amounts based on the information in submitted expense reports. VAT-Aware Expense Processing : VAT values are incorporated into the expense review and processing workflow, reducing the need for manual tax calculations. Enhanced VAT Reporting : VAT amounts captured from employee expenses are aggregated and reported, supporting financial reporting and tax recovery processes. Improved Compliance : Standardized VAT handling helps ensure that expense-related tax calculations apply consistently across the organization. Human in the loop : If the VAT calculation is enabled for expense reports, accountants must review VAT calculation and confirm that everything is correct before posting it.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use assigned projects only in the web app
items.description: Expense Agent web app now uses dedicated resource assignments for projects to determine which projects are available to each user when they create or manage expense entries. Key capabilities include: You can assign dedicated resources (employees) to the whole project or to the specific task. Display only projects or/and tasks where the user is assigned as a resource. Automatically filter project lists based on project-resource relationships. Reduce the risk of users selecting projects that aren't relevant to their role or assignments.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Improve duplicates prevention
items.description: Expense Agent can identify and handle duplicated expense submissions. Key capabilities include: Enhanced duplicate detection that identifies expenses with matching or highly similar details, such as amount, date, merchant, receipt, or transaction information. Proactive guidance that alerts employees when it detects a potential duplicate expense in the current expense report, or one that is already posted. Reduced manual review effort by helping prevent duplicate claims from entering approval and reimbursement workflows. Improved expense data integrity through more intelligent validation and comparison of submitted expenses.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - AI-Driven Approvals
items.description: Expense Agent can validate submitted expense reports against approval policies written in natural language and provide approvers with guidance during the review process. After an employee submits an expense report, the system evaluates both the overall report and the individual expense lines to detect potential policy violations, suspicious patterns, or situations that might require closer attention. This process supports policies that aren't limited to exact thresholds or fixed numeric conditions, such as when business class travel is allowed, what qualifies as an appropriate business meal, or when exceptions to preferred hotel standards might be acceptable. The result is additional review context that helps approvers make better-informed decisions without replacing the final human approval step. By running policy validation after submission, the feature can apply controls at the level of a single expense line in the first release. The feature complements existing approval workflows by highlighting issues, providing context, and helping organizations enforce policy consistently while keeping approvers in control of the final decision.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add date ranges and vehicle types in your mileage calculation
items.description: Expense Agent now supports advanced mileage rate configuration based on both effective date ranges and vehicle types, enabling more flexible and accurate mileage reimbursement calculations. This enhancement combines mileage rate scheduling with support for differentiated vehicle categories. Key capabilities include additions on the Mileage Rate Setup page: Define mileage rates that are valid only within specific date ranges, allowing organizations to accommodate rate changes over time. Configure separate mileage reimbursement rates for different vehicle types, such as cars, motorcycles, electric vehicles, or other organization-defined vehicle categories. Automatically apply the correct reimbursement rate based on the travel date and selected vehicle type during mileage expense calculation. Support evolving regulatory requirements, company policies, and regional reimbursement standards without requiring manual recalculation of submitted mileage claims. Administrators can maintain a set of mileage rate records that include both an effective date range and an associated vehicle type. When someone creates a mileage expense, Expense Agent evaluates the trip date and the type of vehicle, and then applies the matching reimbursement rate automatically. This evaluation ensures that mileage claims are calculated using the appropriate rate in effect for the specific travel period and mode of transportation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - More countries and languages
items.description: Expense Agent supports more languages and regions, enabling an experience for users in all countries/regions where Business Central is available, and adding the following languages: Czech, Dutch, Finnish, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Service tools, skills and plugins are now available for Cowork, Code and Scout
items.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into supported Copilot experiences, including Chat, Cowork, Code, and Scout. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365. First-party tools delivered through the Service package on Dynamics 365 MCP respect Dynamics 365 business logic and the user's existing permissions on each call. The package provides a governed foundation for the supported tools and skills. Availability is tracked separately for each experience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Role-based access controls for ERP agents
items.description: Dynamics 365 ERP security administrators can apply additional, agent-specific security restrictions that take effect when a user accesses the ERP through an agent. Administrators define these restrictions using the existing security model — assigning roles, duties, and privileges that apply only to agent-initiated requests, scoped by legal entity — so that a user's agent session can operate with narrower permissions than the same user holds when working directly in the ERP.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
items.description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog
items.description: With the Skills catalog in Copilot Studio, makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent. The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.

items.title: Work IQ: ExpandedContextIQ
items.description: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

items.title: Work IQ: Custom agents + 3P calls
items.description: Enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports - Copilot Chat for GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Copilot Chat. This report will include total active users, Copilot Chat usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Excel Agent
items.description: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built-in formulas and logic. It streamlines data preparation, formulas, and visualization so you can stay focused on the story behind the numbers. Use multi-turn chat to refine your output or open it in Excel for full editing and collaboration. Ideal for financial forecasts, project plans, and decision-making tools. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Live subtitles on voice chat in Copilot when using the quick composer
items.description: Live subtitles for voice chats in Copilot will be available for users to help them follow the conversation when using the quick composer.

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description: Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive The new Prompt Gallery offers ready-to-use prompts for common file tasks, helping you get started quickly, discover what Copilot can do, and customize prompts to fit your needs. Access the Prompt Gallery from: The Copilot button in the bottom-right corner of OneDrive The + button in the Copilot chat pane Select Open Prompt Gallery to explore prompts across categories such as Create, Analyze, Find, and Collaborate.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation updates
items.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing software investments and unlocks more surfaces for the tools their users already rely on.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
items.description: The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. Administrators can explain which tools, models, connectors, and channels are approved for an environment and point makers to the right policy, request process, or support contact. The message appears in the Review pane alongside the agent's blockers and warnings and remains available when the agent has no issues. This gives makers a consistent place to understand organizational expectations and find help without leaving Copilot Studio.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Expand your service offering through subcontractors without the onboarding overhead
items.description: Business value Subcontractors commonly communicate completion through an emailed service report or a message describing the work performed. Dispatchers then have to find the correct assignment, interpret the report, update the booking and work order, and copy important closeout details into Field Service. This manual process delays operational visibility, creates inconsistent service history, and can leave completed bookings or work orders open. Service teams can setup an agent to process subcontractor service reports to prepare a coordinated booking and work-order closeout. This supports faster reconciliation of external work and helps keep scheduling status, operational records, and service history consistent. Feature detail An agent in Dynamics 365 Field Service processes supported emails and service reports, identifies the applicable Field Service work order and active booking, and prepares a coordinated closeout proposal. The proposal can include supported booking and work-order status changes together with completion details extracted from the submission, such as the completion summary, work performed, notes, recommendations, requirements, requested follow-up, actual completion information, and supported labor-duration values. An internal dispatcher or service coordinator reviews the source submission and the proposed values, corrects or selects the supported changes as allowed, and applies them to Field Service. Coordinating the booking and work-order changes keeps scheduling records, operational status, and service history aligned. If the sender is not authorized, the work cannot be matched confidently, multiple bookings could apply, required information is missing, or the message contains no actionable closeout information, the submission is routed for human resolution rather than being silently applied. This feature closes out existing supported bookings and work orders. It does not create new follow-up work, process payroll or invoices, or automatically create parts and product-consumption records unless those capabilities are delivered separately.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business in your open OneDrive and SharePoint documents
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open cloud documents in Copilot Chat in Edge.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Process subcontractor photos, completion documents, and inspection results
items.description: Business value Subcontractors often document completed work through photos, service reports, inspection forms, certificates, and other files. When those documents remain only in a shared mailbox, service teams must manually download, interpret, organize, and reconnect them with the work they support. Important completion evidence and inspection findings can be difficult to find when a customer, dispatcher, auditor, or future technician needs them. Processing subcontractor completion documents as part of the closeout keeps evidence and supported findings connected to the Field Service work. This improves traceability, reduces document-handling effort, and preserves a more complete operational history. Feature detail The Subcontractor Agent processes supported attachments received with a subcontractor submission, including photos, PDFs, service reports, inspection documents, and other supported completion files. It associates those files with the relevant Field Service work so authorized users can find the evidence from the operational record rather than searching the mailbox. The agent can use supported document content when preparing the closeout proposal. For an inspection or task-completion document, this can include extracting supported inspection findings, outcomes, observations, deficiencies, or task results for the internal reviewer to validate and apply to the appropriate Field Service record. The review experience keeps the original document available alongside the proposed structured information so the dispatcher, service coordinator, or other authorized reviewer can compare the extraction with the source. Unsupported, unreadable, encrypted, oversized, or potentially unsafe files are surfaced for appropriate handling instead of being represented as successfully processed. Processing an invoice, parts list, or other financial or consumption document does not by itself create, match, approve, or post a financial transaction or product-consumption record unless that behavior is separately supported.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Close out bookings and work orders from subcontractor service reports
items.description: Business value Subcontractors commonly communicate completion through an emailed service report or a message describing the work performed. Dispatchers then have to find the correct assignment, interpret the report, update the booking and work order, and copy important closeout details into Field Service. This manual process delays operational visibility, creates inconsistent service history, and can leave completed bookings or work orders open. Using the subcontractor's service report to prepare the complete closeout gives service teams a faster and more consistent way to reconcile external work. Booking state, work-order status, and the details of the completed visit can be reviewed together before the internal records are updated. Feature detail The Subcontractor Agent processes a supported email and service report, identifies the applicable Field Service work order and active booking, and prepares a coordinated closeout proposal. The proposal can include supported booking and work-order status changes together with completion details extracted from the submission, such as the completion summary, work performed, notes, recommendations, requirements, requested follow-up, actual completion information, and supported labor-duration values. An internal dispatcher or service coordinator reviews the source submission and the proposed values, corrects or selects the supported changes as allowed, and deliberately applies them to Field Service. Coordinating the booking and work-order changes keeps scheduling records, operational status, and service history aligned. If the sender is not authorized, the work cannot be matched confidently, multiple bookings could apply, required information is missing, or the message contains no actionable closeout information, the submission is routed for human resolution rather than being silently applied. This feature closes out existing supported bookings and work orders. It does not create new follow-up work, process payroll or invoices, or automatically create parts and product-consumption records unless those capabilities are delivered separately.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations can also extend the with custom experiences and agents available to frontline and back-office users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description: We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation. The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment. The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: PowerPoint: Skills in Brand Kit
items.description: Upload skill (.md file) in Brand Kit and use within PPT Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
items.description: Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography. Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable connectors that don't meet their organization's policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
items.description: You can now reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
items.description: You can now attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
items.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay-As-You-Go usage
items.description: Enables metered, pay-as-you-go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre-assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
items.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

items.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
items.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
items.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
items.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.
